entry.title: Resolution 612 (2024-2026) (Hawaiʻi County): FC-165: Recommended adoption - 8/4/2026
entry.content:
AUTHORIZES THE PAYMENT OF FUNDS FROM LATER FISCAL YEARS TO ENTER INTO A MULTI-YEAR AGREEMENT FOR ONLINE LEGAL RESEARCH SERVICES AND LEGAL PRINT RESOURCES FOR THE OFFICE OF THE CORPORATION COUNSEL

Authorizes the Mayor to enter into a five-year agreement with an approximate monthly cost of $13,522.08 until December 31, 2026, and then $14,245 per month until the end of year one, with an increase seven of percent per year thereafter for proprietary software and other services.

Latest action: FC-165: Recommended adoption - 8/4/2026
